narrative.overview: An abstract soft-form 3D world where user choices physically compose the character's scene, with quiet native controls around it.

rules.name: No Moral Lighting
rules.body: Growth adds breadth and specificity rather than turning darkness into goodness.

rules.name: Contact
rules.body: Every spawned object settles through weight, contact shadow, and character response.

dos: Make each choice visibly recompose character, prop, and space.
Keep no more than three ambient loops active at once.
donts: Do not trace or ship the supplied quality-reference asset.
Do not use mascot proportions, hyper-detail, or photoreal materials.
Do not use generic gamification rewards or scene decay.
